summary: Implementation plan for the leave request (nghỉ phép) system. Covers: (1) Database schema — leave_balances table + att_requests columns, (2) TypeScript types, (3) leaveService.ts with balance calculation logic, (4) Employee Portal UI — new Leave tab with balance cards and request form, (5) Admin approval UI — new tab in Attendance app for approving/rejecting leave requests. Business rules: 1 month = 1 leave day for fulltime employees, accrued quarterly, usable in the next quarter, expires if unused.
